pr_comments: Going to hold off on reviewing this until the prereq is dealt with as due to the merging in-between it's difficult to see what the actual change of this PR is and give feedback on it.
review applies to previous pr i guess. not going to repost there
Tried to see if I can merge master back in here but there's been so many changes it's nigh unmergeable. It would likely be easier to just rewrite this PR off master at this point.

> Tried to see if I can merge master back in here but there's been so many changes it's nigh unmergeable. It would likely be easier to just rewrite this PR off master at this point.

It was actually just a conflicting of the new written `TestSceneHyperDashColouring` so I fixed it, should be good now.

I went ahead and removed the `DEFAULT_CATCHER_HYPER_DASH_COLOUR` thing entirely myself. It feels like an okay thing to do as it simplifies matters significantly while having barely noticeable (at least to me) visual implications.

The rest of this seems relatively sane as far as I can tell.

review_comments: as mentioned in discord, this container should be displayed in the test scene. you've regressed the test as it stands.

This test used to provide `null` for `additiveTarget` so I thought there won't be a problem with providing a dummy `Container`? 

Moreover, providing a real `additiveTarget` here sounds exactly like what `CatcherArea` provides, which has an own test scene (`TestSceneCatcherArea`), why not just remove this test scene if it's worthless.
i guess it's fine for this case, as input is also not handled here.
